capabilities: Poll the Riverbed outbox on a set interval
Write each capture as a Markdown file in a chosen folder
Confirm delivery back to Riverbed so captures are not repeated
Test the base URL and API token
Show sync progress and outcome in the status bar
extras: Not yet in the community plugins directory; installed via BRAT or manually. The API token is stored in plaintext in the plugin settings file, and the README warns to exclude .obsidian/plugins/ from version control.
problem: Captures saved in Riverbed's reader sit in its outbox and never reach the vault, so they cannot join an existing inbox workflow.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT from Obsidian's community plugins browser and enable it.

summary: Polls a Riverbed outbox on an interval and writes each saved capture into a chosen vault folder as a Markdown note.
